policy.translation_scope: one vertical translation per official BU_ID owner
policy.translation_formula: shift_m = quantile_q(dtm_z - source_ground_z) over unique official ground-face vertices for the owner
policy.positive_post_residual_meaning: building base above sampled terrain (potential float)
policy.negative_post_residual_meaning: building base below sampled terrain (potential burial)
policy.selection_metric: lowest vertex absolute residual p95 among tested quantiles
policy.tie_breaker: lower owner max-absolute-residual p95, then lower absolute quantile distance from 0.5
policy.note: Policy comparison only. Even the selected numerical candidate is not a final world-Y or runtime authorization.
